title: Capability facets endpoint + onboarding hooks for version-affinity and perf profiles
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: customers and runtime routing need richer machine-readable metadata about models beyond a single 'profile' blob. Current manifest endpoints list profiles but do not expose granular capability facets (e.g., context_window, max_request_tokens, streaming_latency_class, kv_cache_behavior, quantization_recommendation, throughput_class) or hints for version-affinity and pinning semantics. This makes it hard for router policies, SDKs, and Dedicated/private deployments to select compatible fallback variants without brittle heuristics.

Proposal: introduce a small set of API changes and onboarding hooks: 1) New endpoint GET /v1/models/{model_id}/capability-facets that returns a list of named facets for a model (human-readable and machine-consumable). Example facets: "context_window": "32768", "throughput_tokens_per_sec": "12000", "streaming_latency_class": "p95-50ms", "kv_cache_support": "prefetchable|shared|none", "quantization_safe": "int8|int4|fp16", "determinism_level": "low|medium|high". 2) Extend existing /v1/models/{model_id}/profiles to include a 'pinning_hints' array containing version-affinity signals (e.g., recommended_version, compatible_versions, incompatible_features) that the router can use to keep a session pinned to a variant. 3) Add an onboarding hook (POST /v1/models/{model_id}/onboard-complete) that the model ingestion pipeline can call after a new model/version is validated to trigger profile publication and signal compatibility gates. 4) Versioning: all new fields are additive and namespaced under facet_xxx and pinning_hint_xxx; we will return v1 schema with an explicit schema_version header and a deprecation/compatibility policy in the response.

Backward compatibility: defaults must preserve current behavior. If capability-facets is absent, router falls back to the legacy profile endpoint. SDKs should treat facets as advisory and implement graceful degradation.

Success criteria: - New endpoint implemented and documented in API spec. - Internal router and Dedicated autoscaler use facets to make at least two routing decisions (context-window safety and quantization compatibility) in canary. - Onboarding hook used by model-ingestion pipeline to publish profiles for 95% of new model uploads in staging. - No customer-facing regressions for models without facets.

Migration notes: - Provide a small server-side translator that maps existing profile fields into capability-facets for legacy models during rollout. - SDK changes: add Model.capabilityFacets() accessor and Model.pinningHints() helper with guard rails. - Deprecation: if any field is renamed in future versions, maintain the old field for two releases with a warning header.

Open questions: - Should facets be normalized numeric metrics or freeform strings for early rollout? Proposal: numeric where possible (context_window, throughput), enums for semantics (kv_cache_support), strings for human notes. - How to express multi-variant models where a single model id maps to many flavors (quantized vs fp16)? We propose 'variant_id' in pinning_hints.

APIs and contracts to document: - GET /v1/models/{id}/capability-facets - response schema examples and schema_version header - GET /v1/models/{id}/profiles (extend with pinning_hints) - POST /v1/models/{id}/onboard-complete - header based feature flags: X-Redwood-Schema-Version, X-Model-Profile-Source

Security: publishing of facets is not user-sensitive but must be visible only to callers with model-read scope for private deployments. See security_review_required flag below.
comments: 2026-02-21 - Sync: met with model-ingest and runtime teams. Agreed on the high-level facets list and that schema_version header is required. Action: Ravi to draft OpenAPI changes.

2026-02-25 - Engineering review: alternative considered was embedding facets into existing profiles only, but that would make router parsing heavier. Decided to keep a separate endpoint for faster lookups and caching.
2026-03-01 - Design feedback (Priya): prefer enums for cache behavior and quantization safety to avoid divergent string formats across model publishers. Updated proposal accordingly.

2026-03-03 - Security review requested: flagged for access control in private deployments (KMS metadata not to be exposed). See Confluence note: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/INF/pages/Model+Facets+Design

2026-03-05 - Progress: initial OpenAPI draft posted in GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api-spec/pull/482. Router prototype patched to consult capability-facets when present. Canaries scheduled next week.
